text:
The header requirements pass the clarity check. `text-check` printed no flags, so nothing needed rewriting. I logged one "clear" line in `flags.jsonl`.

It's an agent brief, so the owner-facing checks (page screenshots, ticked asks) don't apply to it.

The Overview proposal is clear. I made no changes to it, and logged one "clear" line in `flags.jsonl`.

`node Server/text-check.mjs` returned no flags for the folder. The proposal is a brief for agents, not an owner-facing page. It names the exact files to build, what is out of scope (2b–2d), a "cut first if short" list, and a checklist of numbers and screenshots to produce.
ended its first turn with no output and no cost: its prompt was probably blocked (a hook timeout). Treat it as a failed start and respawn it.

The slim sessions header is finished and committed on `worktree/sessions-header` (not merged). The last log line is in the header folder's `session.jsonl`.

- **One row:** at 390 px the header is a single row (Today, search, Filters). The Table/Rail toggle, page links, chips and counts all live in the Filters menu.
- **First card:** its top is 199 px at 390 (417 on main). A scrolled-down check of the sticky header on a long list did not happen in the final run, because the Today view had only 3 sessions. The earlier run showed the header pinned at the top at both widths, before the final toggle move.
- **Counts at 390:** This month shows 88 sessions. Show-closed stays at 88, the same as main (the data seems to hold no closed sessions). The "clarity check" role chip goes from 88 to 388.
- **Smoke:** `/framework/ai/sessions/` is reported as FAIL, from two 404s on `session-tree.json` and `session-index.json`. These are generated data files that the worktree doesn't have. I didn't run smoke on main to confirm it passes there. There were no JS page errors, and `node --check` is clean.
- **Shots:** all five requested shots are saved in the header folder, along with `shot-390-filters.png`. The 1920 shots predate the toggle move and were not re-taken.
- **Readme:** I added the one sentence to `public/framework/ai/sessions/readme.md`, under "How data is read".

The stale-doc fix the reviewer asked for is already on `worktree/sessions-header`, in commit `452852bf1`. I made no edits this turn.

- **Docs fixed:** `grid-loading.md` now says the list opens on Today and names the range menu. `views-plan.md` names the range menu too, and the search box is capped at 24em.
- **Not done:** the `classic: true` option and `data_url` are still undocumented in `ai/AISession/readme.md`. I left that for your doc pass.
- **Not fixable on my side:** "show closed" going 88 → 88 is a data fact, since the data has no closed sessions. `review.mjs` shooting `/sessions/v/` instead of the changed page is a tool issue for the system architect.
- **Log:** I logged this reply to `session.jsonl`.

I'm done and idle. The slim header is landed on `worktree/sessions-header` and not merged. The reviewer's second-round findings are answered in `session.jsonl`, and the stale docs were fixed in commit `452852bf1`. I'm waiting for the mastermind to review and merge.

The session cards now show four things (title, cost line, child sessions, state), committed as `84a8644ed` on `worktree/sessions-header` and not merged. I could not see the child-session line or the cost line draw, and I did not run the separate root-session count the brief asked for.

- **Not seen drawing:** the worktree has no generated `session-tree.json` or `session-index.json`, so the cards show the fallback `$0.00` and no child-session line. That line reads `tree[id].kids` and is omitted when a session has none. I did not run `smoke.mjs` this turn.
- **Card contents:** the title is one line with an ellipsis, then the cost line from `AICost.cost_line`, then the state with "N child sessions · M in all" on one line.
- **First screen at 390:** 3 cards before (shot from main) and 5 after. The worktree and main hold different data, so this is only a rough comparison.
- **Card count:** the page drew 14 cards at 390. I compared nothing against root sessions in range, so I have not shown that "cards drawn" equals "root sessions in range".
- **Shots:** `before-390.png`, `after-390.png` and `after-1920.png` are in the `cards/` folder, taken with `?view=rail`.
- **Readme:** I added the sentence on `classic: true` and the `data_url` getter to `ai/AISession/readme.md`.

I logged the commit and shots in the cards folder's `session.jsonl`.

All three fixes are done, committed as a new commit on `worktree/sessions-header` (not merged), and logged in `cards/session.jsonl`. I did not rerun `smoke.mjs`.

1. **Root sessions only:** the rail now drops any row that has a parent in `AISessionRows.tree`; the table keeps its nesting. On one page load the grid held 8 rows, 6 had no parent, and 6 cards were drawn, so the two numbers agree. Toggling Table/Rail now re-applies the filter.
2. **Tighter cards:** each card is 57 px at 390 (was about 115) and 65 px at 1920. All 7 cards that exist today fit on the first 390 screen, up from 5. DataGrid's own CSS is untouched; the override is scoped to the sessions page rail.
3. **The 404s:** the console shows six 404s, not five. Five are distinct URLs, and I named them in the log:
   - `/framework/ai/page-work.json`
   - `/framework/ai/tasks.json`
   - `/framework/ai/usage.json`
   - `/framework/ai/index.json`
   - `/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/25/index.json`

   They are generated, gitignored files that this worktree doesn't have, so none come from the branch. `monorepo.localhost` shows none.

I took `after-390.png` and `after-1920.png` through `http://sessions-header.localhost`. The `127.0.0.1:51319` address showed no sessions today. The 1920 run timed out once and passed on the second try.

I wrote `review.md` in the `cards/` folder with `verdict: fix`: four `[fix]` findings and four `[note]` items. I did not open the worktree, run the page or run any count; I read the diff, `session.jsonl`, the readmes and `after-390.png`.

- **Readme sentence:** it went into `ai/AISession/readme.md`, but the task asked for `public/framework/ai/sessions/readme.md`, which still says nothing about the four-part card or root-only. The AISession bullet also mixes the card sentence with the unrelated `classic: true` text and leaves out the new root-only rule.
- **Count script:** the "cards drawn equals root sessions" check came from one page load (8 rows, 6 roots, 6 cards). No script is saved in the task folder, so a fresh agent cannot re-run it.
- **Child counts unseen:** the child-session line was never seen drawn from a real tree. `roots_for_cards` shows every row when `AISessionRows.tree` is missing.
- **Orphaned children:** `roots_for_cards` also drops every row that has a parent. A child whose parent falls outside the time range disappears from the rail entirely, where the requirement said to filter only rows whose parent is in the list.

The notes cover the cost wording, which matches `AICost.cost_line` ("$2.37 this session · with children …") rather than the owner's "own · with children" example. They also cover the "in all" count the requirements said to cut first, which was kept.

I'm done and idle. The three card fixes are committed on `worktree/sessions-header` (not merged) and logged in `cards/session.jsonl`, and I'm waiting for the mastermind's review. I did not rerun `smoke.mjs` after the last commit.

The new Overview is built and committed on `worktree/session-overview` (last commit 3e5e5ff43). I did not merge it. The full log line is in the brief's `session.jsonl`.

- **Session page:** `SessionOutlineView` now replaces `SessionFeed` as the Overview, drawn from the DOM-free `SessionOutline`. It groups work by child session and draws one full-width row per task. `SessionFeed.js` is kept but no longer used.
- **Children of e00f55c9:** 99 found, with `self` excluded. The sources found 5 from `sessions` lines, 96 from tree nodes, 0 from `links.children` and 0 from snapshot `parent`.
- **Drill-down:** each child's name links to its own page. The deputy (`d9c3caec`) has 44 children, then 1, then 0 at the level below.
- **Tab visibility:** child sessions show no Chat or Coverage tab. `e00f55c9`, a VS Code tab, does.
- **Task counts:** `SessionOutline` reports 500 tasks drawn and the view put 500 rows in the DOM. On the fixture test the independent count agrees, 11 = 11.
- **Checks:** `SessionOutline.test.mjs` passes, `node --check` is clean on every edited file, and `node Server/smoke.mjs` printed no FAIL. I only ran smoke against that session page; it also checked `/framework/` and `/framework/ai2/`.
- **Shots:** all are in the brief folder: `before-*`, `after-*`, `after-proof-1920`, `path-1` to `path-5` and `drill-1` to `drill-4`.
- **Owner path at 390:** AI to Sessions to `e00f55c9` opens the Overview with no `?tab=`, and clicking Chat then switches the tab.
- **Bug found on the way:** `sessions.json` has no row for most sessions, so the detail page looked in the wrong folder and the session's record never loaded. `AISessionDetail` now finds the folder from the day indexes.
- **Play/pause/stop buttons:** they show by task state (start, pause, resume, stop, approve). A click applies the verb locally and appends `{verb:{}}` to that task's own log. The Overview now hides them with `row(t, {verbs:false})`; the Tasks tab keeps them.
- **Not done:** a done task's proof has no commit field when the task records none, and it says so. Chat and Coverage at 390 still start below the tall stats card; that is outside my fence.
- **Out-of-date docs:** I already updated the Overview description in `AISession/readme.md` and in the "One session" line of `sessions/readme.md`.

The fix round is done on `worktree/session-overview` (last commit `4752393b6`, not merged), but I couldn't send this report to `mastermind-sessions-page`. My first send used the wrong parameter, and the Servex tools disconnected when Servex restarted. The same one-line-per-finding report is already in the brief folder's `overview/session.jsonl` (the last line, 9 lines total).

- **(1) Declined, fallback taken.** The Overview row is a fold summary with a state icon, a 2-line title clamp, the child session's model/cost/state line and an in-place proof. Folder-only tasks have no `Task` object, so `TaskView.row` would have needed a second layout mode and a full re-proof. I deleted the unused `verbs` option from `TaskView.js` and corrected `AISession/readme.md` line 8, which wrongly said the rows use `row(t,{verbs:false})`. The law-6 gap (one shared task-row component) stays open as later work.
- **(2) Fixed.** The 10-second timer is gone. `AISessionDetail` awaits the folder lookup and builds `SessionWork` once per folder.
- **(3) Fixed.** `Day.range` is now the one day list. The day-index fetches use `Promise.all` in both `folder_from_day` and `read_snaps`.
- **(4) Fixed.** A session with children but no work of its own now says "No work of its own yet." (visible in `drill-3.png`).
- **(6) Fixed.** The same-value ternary and the stray double space are removed.

Notes I acknowledged without changing code:
- There is no class page with live instances yet.
- 99 children is a long scroll on a phone.
- Cost lines read "with children …" because Servex's cost lookup is stubbed in the worktree, so re-shoot on main after merge.

Checks:
- **Node test:** 11 tasks drawn = 11 expected.
- **`node --check`:** clean.
- **Smoke:** no FAIL. The 404 warnings are for gitignored data files that don't exist in the worktree.
- **Real data:** 500 tasks drawn = 500 rows in the DOM.
- **Re-shot:** `after-390`, `after-1920`, `after-proof-1920`, `drill-1` to `drill-4` at 390, and `drill-1-1920` to `drill-4-1920`, all in the brief folder.

Idle and finished: the fix round for the reviewer's findings is done on `worktree/session-overview` (last commit `4752393b6`, not merged). The one-line-per-finding report is the last line of `overview/session.jsonl` in the brief folder. Findings 2, 3, 4 and 6 are fixed. Finding 1 is declined: I deleted the unused `verbs` option from `TaskView.js` and corrected `AISession/readme.md` line 8 instead. The node test, `node --check`, smoke and re-shoots are done. I'm waiting on `mastermind-sessions-page` to review and merge.

The Timeline proposal is clear. `node Server/text-check.mjs` returned no flags for the folder, so I made no rewrite. I read it as an agent brief, so I didn't shoot a page. I logged a "clear" line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

The Timeline tab is built and committed on `worktree/session-timeline`, but not merged or pushed. The mastermind merges after review, and a short report is the last line of the timeline `session.jsonl`, since I didn't send one by message.

- **Short id:** `/sessions/e00f55c9/` now resolves to the full session (`139038f0e`). The root cause was in `StoreFolder`: a redirect line made the target's dated session folder draw as a moved task, so the page showed the task view instead of the session page.
- **Timeline tab:** right after Overview, and `?tab=timeline` opens it. It has `SessionTimeline.js`, `SessionTimelineRows.js`, `SessionTimeline.css` (prefix `stl-`, registered in `css-scopes.txt`) and a shared `SessionPopover.js`, which the list header's Filters now uses too.
- **Live:** it adds no fetch of the record and reuses the existing `SessionTasks` tail. New lines appeared with no reload (a note appended to the deputy's record took it from 4 events to 5).
- **Filters:** log and tag lines are off by default.
- **The two numbers agree:** e00f55c9 with every filter on draws 763 rows. That is 603 record lines plus 160 prompts plus 0 landed children, counted independently in node on the same files. `SessionTimeline.test.mjs` checks the same sum on a fixture (17 = 13 + 3 + 1) and passes.
- **Phone:** at 390px there is no sideways scroll, the list opens at the bottom, and rows are at most two lines. I dropped the "from owner" line from task-added rows to get there.
- **Other checks:** `node Server/smoke.mjs` shows no FAIL, `node --check` passes on every edited `.js`, and the readmes are updated (`ai/AISession/readme.md` and the "One session" line in `ai/sessions/readme.md`).
- **Not proved on the real page:** e00f55c9 has no landed children, so the landed row was proved only by the fixture.
- **Shots:** all are in the timeline task folder (main tree) and git-ignored. They are `before-390`, `before-main-390`, `after-390`, `after-390-all` (all filters on), `after-1920`, `empty-390`, `path-1` to `path-4` (owner's path to e00f55c9's Timeline) and `path-5`/`path-6` (deputy d9c3caec).
- **Deputy shots:** d9c3caec's record is only 4 lines (1 shown by default), so its Timeline is short.
- **Stuck state:** a session whose files never answer sat on "Reading this session's record…" forever. I added a 4-second deadline after which an empty list says "No events".
- **Sticky stats bar:** it is about 285px tall at 390, a third of the phone screen on every tab, and it covers the top of anything below it. It's outside my fence, so I only logged it; the fix is a one-line bar on phones.
- **Uncommitted files in the worktree:** the copied generated data, plus the deputy's `session.jsonl`, which I overwrote with main's 4 lines. None of it should be merged.

The stale `after-1920.png` is retaken: it no longer shows "from owner", and the child row's link and meta line draw cleanly. The new shot is in both trees, but it is git-ignored, so it isn't in a commit.

I left the other notes in your review alone:
- **Phone layout:** the sticky stats bar takes a third of the screen at 390px and needs its own task. It is already logged.
- **Two scroll areas:** the timeline scrolling inside its own box is deliberate, so the list can open at the bottom.
- **Prompt file read twice:** one shared read would be a clean follow-up.
- **Two older docs:** `ai/sessions/doc/ui/detail-layout.md` and `classes.md` still miss the new tab.

I made no new code changes.

The session page now fits a phone, and the changes are committed on `worktree/session-phone-fit` (83828218b). The smoke test (`Server/smoke.mjs`) was still running when I stopped, so it has not passed yet. I did not merge.

At 390 px:

| Height | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Stats bar | 287 px | 39.5 px |
| Tab row | 166 px, three rows | 44.4 px, one line |

- **Stats bar:** below 600 px it is one line (cost · state · running). A tap opens the full grid, no longer sticky. The `after-390.png` bar shows "? this session · with children" because the worktree server gave no cost for this session.
- **Tab row:** Overview · Timeline · Chat · Tasks · More ▾. More ▾ opens a `SessionPopover` with Board, Coverage, Cost, Models and tokens, Related, Task queue → and Full screen. It shows as on when a tab inside it is open. Chat and Coverage stay hidden when `chat_ok` is false, and the old `?tab=` keys still work.
- **One scroll:** on a phone the page scrolls and the Timeline opens at its last row. The inner 72dvh list box stays at 600 px and wider, because the desktop panel is short beside the sticky bar.
- **Cleanups:**
  - Coverage now reads the Timeline's prompt tail instead of fetching `prompts.jsonl` again.
  - `SessionTimeline.js` calls `SessionTimelineRows` directly, with the aliases removed.
  - The over-indented `if (key === "timeline")` line is fixed.
  - `detail-layout.md` and `classes.md` are updated.

Shots are in the task folder: `before-390`, `after-390`, `after-390-more`, `after-1920`.

At 390 the first screen shows the Timeline's newest rows, not its first, since it opens at the end. In the `after-1920.png` shot the Timeline list showed its first rows, yet a probe at the same moment found it scrolled to the end. I left that unexplained.

The findings are logged in the task's `session.jsonl`. I have not re-run `SessionTimeline.test.mjs` since the edits.
Waiting for the baseline result.
The proof run is going in the background; I'll read its result when it finishes.
Docs are edited; the proof re-run is going in the background and I'll log the three counts and commit once it finishes.
The second proof run is going in the background.
Re-running the proof with the menu fix.
